_meta.description: Judge calibration set. 30 (context, claim) pairs, deliberately balanced 15 supported / 15 unsupported so Cohen's kappa is meaningful - a set skewed to one class lets a judge that always answers the same way score high agreement while carrying no information.
_meta.how_to_use: The judge scores every case; kappa compares its verdicts against the labels. expected_label is the authored intent and is objective for the unsupported half, since those claims simply do not appear in the context. human_label is null until YOU grade them in the dashboard; your labels take precedence and are stronger evidence.
_meta.note: Contexts are short excerpts in resume style, NOT verbatim resume text. The judge is being measured on its ability to check support, which does not require the real document.
